MORE:
Premium Capital Market & Investments Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 03/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve & take on record the unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026 as per Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and any other items as may be decided by the Board of Directors.

In this connection and in continuation of our intimation regarding Closure of Trading Window for the Insiders of the Company vide letter dated September 28, 2026, the trading window for dealing in the securities of the Company is already closed for the Insiders of the Company from Thursday, October 01, 2026 till 48 hours after the declaration and publication of unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended on September 30, 2026.
